items.title: Chew some Bubblegum
items.detail: Open a perk card pack or collect from Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron.

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Public Events spawn every 20 minutes on the map or join an Activity.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Use V.A.T.S. to target legs at Morgantown Airport during Spooky Scorched event.

items.title: Eat Mystery Candy
items.detail: Kill Spooky Scorched or collect from Candy Bowls in player C.A.M.P.s, then eat.

items.title: Kill a Spooky Scorched
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport; they spawn as Legendary enemies during the event.

items.title: Plant a Crop in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Harvest a plant and then plant the seed in your C.A.M.P. or workshop.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint rather than walk; keep weapon holstered to move faster.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors at train stations.

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Find five Garden Gnomes at The General's Steakhouse in the Mire behind the main building.

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join a Daily Ops public team and complete the Daily Operation instance.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town via Bounty Board in The Last Resort saloon; track and eliminate the target.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for reliable spawns; use energy weapons.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from the wild or plant crops in your C.A.M.P. for on-demand gathering.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any outfit, hat, or mask with 'Costume' in its description before killing.

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Fast travel to Wavy Willard's Water Park in Toxic Valley for reliable spawns.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days by completing all six other dailies.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build and submit a C.A.M.P. or Shelter inspired by slasher movies for prizes including Atoms and exclusive in-game titles.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt masked, costumed Legendary Scorched enemies to collect Mystery Candy and themed event rewards.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn experience at double rate during this weekend event.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish this weekend.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double Scoreboard progress and bonus Caps during this event.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special anniversary-themed event with unique rewards and activities.
